title: Zara finds shapes in the mosque

scenes.caption: Shapes on a walk.
scenes.say: Zara goes for a walk with her brother. She spots shapes everywhere.

scenes.caption: A cube, a sphere, a cone.
scenes.say: A dice is a cube. A ball is a sphere. A party hat is a cone.

scenes.caption: Tile pattern.
scenes.say: At the mosque there is a tile pattern. Squares and triangles repeat.

scenes.caption: A mirror line.
scenes.say: Fold the star down the middle. Both halves match. That is symmetry!

scenes.caption: A robot facing right.
scenes.say: Zara's brother has a toy robot. It faces right.

scenes.caption: A quarter turn.
scenes.say: A quarter turn to the right. Now the robot faces down.

scenes.caption: A half turn.
scenes.say: Another quarter turn makes a half turn. It faces left!

scenes.caption: Shukriya, Zara!
scenes.say: Shapes, symmetry and turns are everywhere. Shukriya, Zara!
